title: Staged search with a coverage map
notes: Flown on sctsvr6 (headless, Docker, Mesa lavapipe) on 4 parallel lanes at one SHA after an unscored 6-run shakedown (6/6 valid); R12C dropped by the operator. 18/18 valid. 5/18 (initial 5/6, final 0/6, dynamic 0/6) against R11's 11/18: 6 outcomes lost, 0 gained. In final the goal was never seen in 5 of 6 runs; the drone flew 60-80 m but stayed within 6-18 m of its start (R11: 13-32 m), with 12-35 turn-arounds a run (R11: 1-17), and g05 under a19's map read 39-67% of strips blocked (R11's g03: 8-36%).
